alt_text: A three-pin male XLR connector sits against swirling blue and turquoise brushwork.
art_note: Directional brushwork and thick impasto evoke the expressive surface of Van Gogh's portraits.

alt_text: A female XLR connector with three sockets and a release tab poses above folded cable loops against a hazy landscape.
art_note: Soft tonal transitions and a distant atmospheric landscape evoke Leonardo's sfumato and portrait composition.

alt_text: A quarter-inch TS plug with one black insulating ring stands beside a guitar in a subdued blue room.
art_note: A restricted blue palette and solitary subject evoke the melancholy associated with Picasso's Blue Period.

alt_text: A quarter-inch TRS plug with two black insulating rings stands against a black grid with primary-color rectangles.
art_note: Orthogonal black lines and primary-color fields evoke the geometric vocabulary of De Stijl.

alt_text: A quarter-inch TS plug with one insulating ring and a heavy cable lies against an ochre cave-painting background.
art_note: Earth pigments, animal silhouettes, and textured stone evoke prehistoric cave painting.

art_reference: Vermeer, Girl with a Pearl Earring
alt_text: A small 3.5 mm TRS plug with two insulating rings replaces the pearl earring in a Vermeer-inspired portrait.
art_note: Luminous directional light and restrained blue and ochre evoke Dutch Golden Age oil painting.

alt_text: Red and white RCA plugs with center pins and split outer rings repeat across four brightly colored panels.
art_note: Repeated consumer objects, saturated color contrasts, and screenprint texture evoke Pop Art.

alt_text: A round locking speaker-cable connector with a recessed keyed face and no projecting pins appears against angular architecture.
art_note: Polished sculptural planes and architectural geometry evoke Art Deco portrait painting.
